summary: The PDF states that participants were randomly assigned to one of nine cells of a 3 x 3 between-subjects design that crossed task with an unnamed LLM chat assistant at temperature 0.1, the same assistant at temperature 1.2, or no LLM assistance, and the assistant was offered for each participant's own task with optional use (PDF p. 2, Sections III.A and III.B; PDF p. 3, Section IV; Figure 1, PDF p. 5). Every assignment field, arm, and ai_tool entry in the form matches the text and Table I, so the coding is not refuted and criterion 1 holds.
